title: add this to the task, we need to show a red error if an agent errors out (use same red as stop buton)
summary: I've added the red error to RUS202's task. When an agent fails to start, its cloud machine fails, a turn ends in an error, or it stalls, its row in the agents list and in the channel's members list turns red, in the same red as the Stop button. The agent's chat will also show the reason in red.
